# OnlySocial

OnlySocial is a social media management platform for managing accounts, media, tags, posts, and account groups across a workspace.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/onlysocial/.

## Actions

- **Create Tag**: Create a named, color-coded tag in the configured OnlySocial workspace.
- **Delete Tag**: Permanently delete one tag from the configured OnlySocial workspace.
- **Get Media** (read-only): Get one OnlySocial media file by UUID, including its URLs, type, and alt-text metadata returned by the provider.
- **Get Post** (read-only): Get one OnlySocial post by UUID with its accounts, tags, and content versions.
- **List Media** (read-only): Return one page of media files from the configured OnlySocial workspace for selection when composing posts.
- **List Posts** (read-only): Return one page of posts from the configured OnlySocial workspace.
- **List Social Accounts** (read-only): List the social accounts connected to the configured OnlySocial workspace, including provider and authorization status.
- **List Tags** (read-only): List all tags in the configured OnlySocial workspace for organizing or filtering posts.
- **Update Tag**: Replace the name and color of an existing OnlySocial tag.
- **Upload Media**: Upload an image or video file to the configured OnlySocial workspace for later use in posts.
